scene_1.text_1: The Slime Belt can transport items like a normal belt.
scene_1.text_2: The difference is that items are not thrown off the end, but continue moving onto the back side of the belt.
scene_1.text_3: The Slime Belt can also move items vertically.
scene_1.text_4: Connected Slime Belts can form a loop.
scene_1.title: Slime Belt
